Focused O0/O2 salinity tests pass, including a manufactured and restricted real-Reference-Richards conservative internal water-face-flux reconstruction. The direct solve includes nonzero qssdi and separately bound nonzero qrot. The A8 O0/O2 FMR transaction/restart suite now passes with nonzero qrot, after correcting incomplete test-only matrix_area_fraction configuration. However the FMR observation does not expose interval-aggregated boundary fluxes or accepted-substep traces, so continuity reconstruction is not connected to FMR and live solute transport is not qualified. A source-backed transaction/restart audit establishes that kernel commit and Restart v2 each own one physical state object and that FMR restart layout is explicitly discriminated. The branch has selected an optional typed salt component plus an independent template/restart layout identity; this design is proposed, not canonically accepted or implemented. No Jarvis interface was changed and no salinity capability is qualified/admitted. Exact B1.11 solute-member bytes, common-state/clone/restart implementation, and live accepted-substep transport binding remain open. This closes no production transaction gap. Current pinned A8 runner verifies the expected macro-route SOLUTE_WATER_CLOSURE and no salt-candidate/receipt leakage at O0/O2. A separate unpersisted base-layout FMR attempt exhausted the canonical substep limit and is recorded as diagnostic only. A second macro-disabled diagnostic at 1e-5 day also hit CANONICAL_STATUS_SUBSTEP_LIMIT (1,438 temporal rejections, zero solver rejections); this remains an unpersisted local experiment. Source-level follow-up found the pinned FMR base-layout temporal evaluator returns huge() unless full and half states are identical; this makes the ad hoc non-macropore route unviable under the current acceptance contract, independently of salt. Source audit now pins the live macro exchange blocker: `qexc_to_matrix_rate` is retained per domain/node in the macropore process and the opt-in FMR trace now preserves the per-domain/node rates, paired macro-water start/end volumes, and ordered per-domain vertical face rates. Positive rate is macro-to-matrix and negative is matrix-to-macro. The macro continuation owns per-domain/node water volume and no salt mass. A new proposed contract records required paired macro/matrix salt state, donor concentration, route boundary receipts and transaction/restart qualification. No code or admitted behavior changes in this contract slice. Latest PR-branch runtime/restart/state sources were reconciled into the local checkout before the focused FMR gate; the direct local gate now passes O0/O2. The prequalification source-hash map was refreshed for the exact local postimage. The stateless matrix/macropore transfer arithmetic kernel is implemented in src/process/mod_solute_macropore_exchange.f90 and passes O0/O2; it uses synchronized start-of-substep donor concentrations, separately records transfer direction, checks donor water/mass availability, and verifies no external salt change. It is deliberately not called from production or the FMR trace. The test-only salt consumer still rejects the live route. The trace now carries macro liquid volumes and vertical faces; macro salt masses and typed salt-bearing boundary receipts remain missing. The current A7 O0/O2 check additionally requires max absolute accepted domain exchange >1e-14 cm/day, so trace preservation is exercised on a nonzero live exchange, not only zero-valued shape/identity. The trace now copies macro `water_domain_cp` before each accepted FMR macropore solve and the matching `macropore_candidate%water_domain_cp` afterward. A7 requires nonzero exchange and water-volume change and checks both arrays are identical through replay/restart. These are attempt-local diagnostics, not committed salt state. Latest local O0/O2 A7/A8 evidence also checks nonzero macro vertical faces, source completeness for the restricted zero-boundary trace, and exact replay/restart identity. source_family_census.initialization: SWINCO != 3 interpolates ZC/CML input to nodes; SWINCO = 3 consumes a warm-start concentration profile and does not reapply the initial table (source-family only).
source_family_census.state: CML is mobile-water concentration; CMSY is dissolved plus adsorbed mass per bulk soil volume; column inventory integrates CMSY over node thickness.
source_family_census.transport: Surface input, inter-node advective/dispersive flux, bottom exchange, lateral drainage, root uptake, optional decomposition; internal solute substeps.
source_family_census.root_salt_uptake: TSCF*qrot*CML is a solute-mass sink; must use the same candidate/accepted qrot as the one root-water sink.
source_family_census.ownership: Dedicated solute-state owner advances candidate salt mass and commits/rolls it back with the physical transaction; Jarvis reads concentration only.
source_family_census.exact_source_limit: All equations and lifecycle details above are source-family corroboration only, not byte-exact B1.11 claims.
